many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0]); bg=max(set(c for r in inp for c in r), key=lambda c: sum(r.count(c) for r in inp))
    comps=[]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if inp[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                col=inp[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and not seen[x][y] and inp[x][y]==col:
                            seen[x][y]=True; st.append((x,y))
                comps.append(comp)
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    for comp in comps:
        cols=set(inp[a][b] for a,b in comp); size=len(comp)
        if size==1 and cols!={bg}:  # single stray
            a,b=comp[0]
            nb=[inp[x][y] for x,y in ((a+x,b+y) for x in (-1,0,1) for y in (-1,0,1) if (x,y)!=(0,0))
                if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and inp[x][y]!=bg]
            cnt=Counter(nb)
            top,n=cnt.most_common(1)[0]
            if len(cnt)==1:
                out[a][b]=top
            else:
                out[a][b]=bg
    return out

def solve(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    counts={}
    for r in inp:
        for c in r: counts[c]=counts.get(c,0)+1
    bg=max(counts,key=lambda c:counts[c])
    Cs=comps_of(inp,bg); comps=[c for c in Cs if len(c['cells'])>1]
    res=[r[:] for r in inp]
    def bbr(b): return (min(q[0] for q in b['cells']),max(q[0] for q in b['cells']),min(q[1] for q in b['cells']),max(q[1] for q in b['cells']))
    def dist(p,b): return min(abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1]) for q in b['cells'])
    for cc in [c for c in Cs if len(c['cells'])==1]:
        p=cc['cells'][0]
        hits=[b for b in comps if bbr(b)[0]<=p[0]<=bbr(b)[1] and bbr(b)[2]<=p[1]<=bbr(b)[3]]
        best=min(hits,key=lambda b:dist(p,b)) if hits else None
        res[p[0]][p[1]]=best['col'] if best else bg
    return res
ti=G['Test input']
out=solve(ti)
bad=[(x,y,ti[x][y],out[x][y]) for x in range(len(ti)) for y in range(len(ti[0])) if out[x][y]!=ti[x][y]]

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
